budget_note: an interactive session has no budget knob, so the 21600 s budget was not enforced on this arm. Reported for comparability only.

stall_note: the account hit its usage limit mid-run and the session sat idle for 3 h 56 min (04:35:12Z to 08:31:37Z). The user's only other message in the whole session was 'I hit my usage limit while you were working, but it has reset now. Please continue from where you left off.', which carries no information about the task. Active time was 6433 s; the 20618 s wall span is mostly that stall.
